claims.text: NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines with favorable generalization ability across multiple benchmarks.
In both easy and hard datasets, NCEL outperforms all baseline methods, indicating its effectiveness in diverse scenarios.
The NCEL approach is efficient for large-scale data due to its unique method of applying graph information and utilizing batch techniques.
